description: PrismML Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B in the PQ2_0 packing (ternary g128, 1.72 bits per weight, 6.70 GiB) with its Q8_0 vision projector: a hybrid 27B-class vision-language model (48 gated-DeltaNet plus 16 full-attention layers) derived from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. The weights sit in a blockwise Hadamard-rotated basis and need the PrismML llama.cpp fork; stock llama.cpp cannot run them. Only the PQ2_0 file and the Q8_0 projector are cataloged.
